pin.title: Witkoppen Road at the Braamfontein Spruit bridge, Paulshof/Fourways (approx.): car swept away by floodwater, driver rescued from a tree, 25 Nov
pin.location_note: APPROX. Braamfontein Spruit bridge on Witkoppen Road at Achter Road (Fourways Review); Witkoppen Road, Fourways (SABC News). Point placed where Witkoppen Road meets Achter Road (Nominatim: Achter Road, Paulshof, -26.0330, 28.0579; Witkoppen Road segment -26.0374, 28.0589). Overpass was at capacity, so the bridge itself was not looked up. Street level, about 400 m.
